alt: 老師溫柔地陪孩子練習畫幼苗，孩子在耐心引導下逐漸露出笑容；窗外柔和春雨滋養著新綠植物。
scene_prompt: 春風化雨 means a teacher's gentle, patient guidance helps pupils gradually grow, like nourishing spring weather. Modern classroom art corner: a kind female teacher sits beside a shy child and patiently demonstrates how to sketch a simple growing plant on her own blank paper, while the child carefully tries the same on a separate sheet, their tense face beginning to relax into a smile. Another child nearby confidently shows a modest finished plant drawing, evidence of gradual learning. The teacher has a gentle encouraging expression, no commanding gesture; learning and caring teacher-student relationship are central. Behind them the open classroom window admits soft spring breeze moving a pale curtain, and outside delicate spring rain nourishes young green seedlings, providing a subtle visual metaphor, not indoor rain. Only three figures, anatomically correct two arms and legs each, natural pencil grips and realistic furniture. Simple plant drawings only, no writing, numbers, words, lettering, signs or speech bubbles. Tender nurturing atmosphere, pencil contours clearly retained over translucent watercolor and paper grain.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling for elementary school readers and readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy browns, generous ivory breathing room. No flat digital blocks, glossy rendering, 3D or imitation of a named artist.
